Container.Name: book_sorter
Container.Overview: Read-only scanner/indexer for a large game-book collection. Walks a directory tree, indexes every file into an embedded Postgres database, and catalogs each book locally (title, publisher, authors, game line and system, catalog number, ISBN incl. cover barcode, year, edition, printing), OCRs image-only PDFs, cleans scanned covers for thumbnails with perceptual hashes, then verifies with a self-hosted AI and — last resort — DriveThruRPG / Open Library / Google Books / RPGGeek. Found data is never overwritten by online sources. Includes a web dashboard with live progress and a searchable table. The collection is mounted read-only.
Container.Description: Read-only game-book collection indexer (embedded Postgres + FastAPI dashboard). Single container; database and thumbnails persist on appdata; the collection is mounted read-only.

Config.Description: Host port for the dashboard

Config.Name: Collection (read-only)
Config.Description: The game-book collection to index. Mounted READ-ONLY.

Config.Description: Embedded Postgres data dir (persist on appdata)

Config.Name: Work dir (scratch/thumbs/ocr)
Config.Description: Scratch, thumbnails and OCR staging live here on a data pool, kept OFF the small docker SSD. Subdirs: tmp/ thumbs/ ocr/.

Config.Name: Temp dir (TMPDIR)
Config.Description: OCR scratch (ocrmypdf.io.*) is written here — on the work pool, never the docker SSD. Cleaned on startup.

Config.Name: Thumbnail dir
Config.Description: First-page thumbnail store (JPEG), on the work pool.

Config.Name: OCR staging dir
Config.Description: Transient OCR output staging, on the work pool.

Config.Name: OCR languages
Config.Description: Tesseract languages (installed: eng deu fra spa por ita pol rus)

Config.Name: OCR workers (default)
Config.Description: Default concurrent OCR tasks (also adjustable per-run in the dashboard)

Config.Name: OCR during scan
Config.Description: Queue + OCR image-only PDFs/djvu automatically while scanning

Config.Name: Documents only
Config.Description: Index only document types; skip images/audio/video/3D-print/archives

Config.Name: Scan on start
Config.Description: Begin scanning automatically when the container starts

Config.Name: Scan workers
Config.Description: Concurrent extraction workers

Config.Name: Hash all types
Config.Description: Also MD5 non-target files (videos/images/archives). Heavy I/O; off by default.

Config.Name: Force rescan
Config.Description: Re-extract every file even if unchanged

Config.Name: Barcode dir
Config.Description: Clean barcode crops (PNG), on the work pool.

Config.Name: Clean scanned covers
Config.Description: Dust removal / border trim / levels on SCANNED covers before thumbnailing. Born-digital covers are never touched.

Config.Name: Ollama URL (local AI verification)
Config.Description: Self-hosted Ollama that checks found fields against each book's credits pages, e.g. http://10.47.40.43:11434. Empty = skip the AI stage.

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: Model used for verification (JSON output).

Config.Name: DriveThruRPG API key
Config.Description: Your DriveThruRPG library API key (read-only, verification only). Empty = skip.

Config.Name: RPGGeek (BGG) app token
Config.Description: BoardGameGeek XML API application token (boardgamegeek.com/applications). Empty = skip. Non-commercial use; data credited to BoardGameGeek.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Logging level
